mapper.select: SELECT e.expense_id, e.amount, e.payment_status, c.category_code AS category_code, p.category_code AS parent_category_code, e.payment_type, e.is_interest_free, e.discount_amount, b.exclude_from_performance FROM expense e JOIN category c ON c.category_id = e.category_id LEFT JOIN category p ON p.category_id = c.parent_category_id LEFT JOIN benefit b ON b.benefit_id = e.applied_benefit_id WHERE e.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND e.payment_date >= #{fromInclusive} AND e.payment_date < #{toExclusive} AND e.payment_status <> 'CANCELED'
SELECT exclusion_type, exclusion_value FROM performance_exclusion WHERE card_id = #{cardId}
SELECT card_id, period_type, tier_id, min_performance_amount, shared_monthly_limit FROM performance_tier WHERE card_id = #{cardId}

SELECT card_id, period_type, tier_id, min_performance_amount, shared_monthly_limit FROM performance_tier WHERE card_id IN
#{cardId}
